description: Healthpeak Properties, Inc. is a Standard & Poor's 500 company that owns, operates and develops high-quality real estate focused on healthcare discovery and delivery in the United States. Originally founded in 1985, it is organized as an umbrella partnership REIT and holds substantially all of its assets and conducts its operations through its operating subsidiary, Healthpeak OP, a consolidated subsidiary of which it is the managing member, and it is a Maryland corporation qualifying as a self-administered REIT headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It has a diversified portfolio of high-quality healthcare properties across three core asset classes of outpatient medical, lab and senior housing real estate, owning, operating and developing outpatient medical buildings, hospitals and lab buildings under the outpatient medical and lab segments.
